description: Zero-dependency Python library and optional CLI that converts matching double quotes to single quotes or the reverse in strings and streams, escaping inner quotes correctly.
rules: Install with pip install quotes-convert and import from quotes_convert: single_quotes, double_quotes, single_quotes_stream, double_quotes_stream.
The CLI needs pip install "quotes-convert[cli]"; use -s or -d to choose the target quote style and -i to edit files in place.
